summary: @servicetitan/navigation preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from oven-sh's GitHub releases (pinned to bun-v1.3.13), makes it executable, and uses that runtime to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated CJS blob `math_init.js` (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, shifted string-array decoder, hex-mangled identifiers, large opaque constant pool). Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is listed in `package.json` `files` (which declares only `dist` and `src`), while the `dist/` tree still contains an intact React navigation library — consistent with trojanization of an otherwise legitimate ServiceTitan package. A React navigation component library has no functional need for a second language runtime or a `math`-named obfuscated blob, and running the payload under an alien runtime evades Node-focused static inspection. Execution fires automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
